column1: # The tree-sitter library and the grammars Tuatara is built with, each fetched
# at one exact commit by tools/grammars.sh. A grammar's pin changes only after
# its colouring rules have been checked against it and tools/fuzz-grammars.sh
# passes for it. A grammar with a file
# syntax/patches/NAME.patch is patched, and its parser generated again when
# the patch changes its grammar.js; tree-sitter is patched with
# Needed only to generate the parsers of patched grammars: the tree-sitter
# program as its release was published (x86-64 Linux), pinned by its SHA-256,
# and what a grammar's grammar.js requires, fetched into NAME/node_modules/.
# languages Helix knows (lisp/modes/more-languages-*.lisp), pinned where Helix pins them
